text:
alex.k: Hey team, first day here in infra — super excited! Quick blocker: my Okta invite shows 'pending' and I don't have a 1Password seat yet. I need to pull infra repos and join the sprint workspace. Who should I ping for temp access to repos/drive/VPN?
onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, @alex.k! Please complete the new hire intake form here: https://intranet/newhire. Once HR finishes provisioning we auto-submit SSO/1P requests. If you need immediate access, ping the IT team in this thread.
marie.it: @alex.k welcome! I'll triage. Can you confirm preferred username (first.last) and the laptop serial? Also do you want a YubiKey shipped or prefer passkey/SMS for MFA? I can create a short-lived dev account for repos while we sort Okta.
alex.k: preferred username is alex.k, laptop serial MBP2022-00123. Please send a YubiKey if possible. For now I need SSH access to infra-config and redwood-inference to run local tests. My public key: `ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIEexamplekey alex@personal-laptop`
jamal: Adding context — Alex needs access to infra-config and redwood-inference repos. @marie.it if you can grant those repos to the temp account that should unblock most tasks. Alex, we'll also send a GitHub invite to your personal email for now.
marie.it: I created temp account `temp_github/alexk_dev` (expires in 72h) and invited your personal email. Okta still shows pending; forwarded to SSO team for a priority look. 1Password seat request filed (ticket INC-4521).
alex.k: Got the GH invite, accepted — thanks. VPN is still blocked because Okta isn't active. Any temporary VPN workaround?
it-support-bot: VPN requires Okta MFA. For short-term access we've enabled a bastion/jumpbox with time-limited credentials. See https://intranet/tools/jumpbox-1 and check your DMs for creds. Use `ssh alexk@jumpbox.internal` and then git from there.
alex.k: Received DM with jumpbox creds and SSH works. Can clone/push from there :tada:
marie.it: YubiKey shipment requested (ETA ~5 business days). If you'd rather not wait we can enable SMS 2FA temporarily — ping me and I can flip that.
jamal: FYI we usually onboard passkeys after initial setup, but if you want earlier deploy access we can pair and add your key to canary.
sarah_pm: Welcome Alex! Please accept the 'Infra onboarding' calendar invite for 2pm today — we'll run through access checklist and quick tour.
alex.k: One more Q — my GSuite alias initially caused a domain mismatch during Okta provisioning. Is there a quick fix?
marie.it: That happens when the alias isn't in the Okta provisioning list. I linked your alias to your primary account and triggered a user sync. Should reflect in ~10 minutes; if it still says pending after 30m reopen the incident and I'll escalate.
alex.k: Sync happened, Okta changed to 'Active' and I can see SSO now. 1Password still pending but jumpbox covers me for the day. Really appreciate the quick help everyone!
jamal: :party_parrot: Welcome aboard, Alex — excited to have you on the team!
